# Sensitive reporting and evidence

Never put credentials, private access allowlists, raw owner workbooks or customer
information into public issues, pull requests, discussions or planning exports.
Use the repository owner's established private contact route for sensitive
findings. No new reporting address, response SLA or security certification is
asserted by this document.

Preserve exact source and affected version, reproduce the bounded failure without
publishing sensitive values, and record remediation and readback through the
owner-controlled audit process. Public planning should retain the issue shape,
revision and gate, not private actor identities or credential contents.
